name: Alin
source:
A mentally-fragile reaper who is not only shy but a scaredy-cat. 
While she is fantastically diligent in her duties, that's perhaps the reason why she demands to be teased and demands to be treated with care.

Her basic skills as a reaper are below average, but she shows extraordinary talent in her specialties. 
Since she doesn't place much value in herself, she tends to let chances for her to display her strength pass her by. 
The type of girl that is intelligent, but lacks the ability to stand up on her own in the world. 
Currently working for Mimiru on various odd jobs.

[In-game profile]
